# OpenEndo

> Patient-facing explainers and an open data hub for endometriosis. Not medical advice.
> Canonical datasets, weekly digests, and knowledge pages live in https://github.com/wckdboy/openendo and are fetched at build time and again in the browser from raw.githubusercontent.com. This file describes the public site.

## How to read the site
- [How we verify](https://openendo.org/sources): sources, method, and limits
- [Index](https://openendo.org/find): page and section index

## Guides
- [Understand](https://openendo.org/learn): symptoms, diagnosis, treatment, living with endometriosis, Denmark
- [Symptoms](https://openendo.org/learn/symptoms)
- [Diagnosis](https://openendo.org/learn/diagnosis)
- [Treatment](https://openendo.org/learn/treatment)
- [Living with endometriosis](https://openendo.org/learn/living)
- [Denmark](https://openendo.org/learn/denmark)
- Danish editions use the `/da` prefix, for example https://openendo.org/da/learn

## Data on this site
- [Dashboard](https://openendo.org/dashboard): recruiting trials, Denmark trials, PubMed counts from the weekly OpenEndo extract
- [Evidence digests](https://openendo.org/evidence): weekly literature digests with PMIDs
- [Research explainer](https://openendo.org/research): docs/what-we-know.html from the data repository
- [Find help](https://openendo.org/access): sourced access.json (medicines, centres, organisations)
- [Knowledge](https://openendo.org/knowledge): docs/knowledge markdown from the data repository

## Canonical repository
- [Data repository llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/llms.txt)
- [meta.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/data/meta.json)
- [funding.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/data/funding.json)
- [Latest digest pointer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wckdboy/openendo/main/docs/research/evidence/weekly/LATEST)

## Citation policy
Medical claims on the guides cite the WHO fact sheet, NICE NG73, or the ESHRE 2022 guideline (PMID 35350465). Trial, paper, and funding figures are the OpenEndo dataset, not hand-maintained copies. A funding call whose deadline has passed is not shown as open.
